ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMEREMPLOYMENT_CRM
AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment AS (
	SELECT 
		BCA.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
		,HASHBYTES('MD5',BCM.STRTEXT4)  AS EmployerId
		,BCM.STRTEXT2 AS JobTitleId
		,BCM.DTDATE1 AS PeriodStartDate
		,BCM.STRTEXT9 AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
		,NULL AS AnnualSalaryAmount
		,NULL AS EmploymentClassificationId
		,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
		,BCD.EMPLOYMENT_STATUS AS EmploymentStatusId
		,NULL AS EmploymentNote
		,BCA.STAFFEMPLOYEEID AS EmployeeId
		,BCD.INCOME_NATURE AS NatureOfIncome
		,'CRM' AS SourceCode
		,BCA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,BCA.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCAD.RECORD_STATUS AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS_DELTA BCAD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS BCA ON BCAD.ACCOUNTID = BCA.ACCOUNTID AND BCAD.BANK_ID = BCA.BANK_ID AND BCA.isLatest = 1
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT STRTEXT2,DTDATE1,STRTEXT9,STRTEXT4,ORGKEY,BANK_ID,TYPE,DEMOGRAPHICID FROM  BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO) BCM  ON BCM.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY AND BCM.BANK_ID = BCA.BANK_ID  AND BCA.isLatest = 1  
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT EMPLOYMENT_STATUS,INCOME_NATURE,EMPLOYERID,ORGKEY,BANK_ID,DEMOGRAPHICID,ACCOUNTID FROM  BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC) BCD  ON BCD.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY  AND BCD.BANK_ID = BCA.BANK_ID  AND BCA.isLatest = 1 AND BCD.DEMOGRAPHICID = BCM.DEMOGRAPHICID
	WHERE BCM.TYPE = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'   AND BCD.ACCOUNTID <> 0

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_SRC AS (
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerId, EmployerId, JobTitleId, PeriodStartDate, EmploymentPositionTypeId, EmploymentStatusId, EmployeeId, NatureOfIncome)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
		,RECORD_STATUS 
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_TGT AS (
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerId, EmployerId, JobTitleId, PeriodStartDate, EmploymentPositionTypeId, EmploymentStatusId, EmployeeId, NatureOfIncome)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
	FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment 
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL



---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmployment(
	[CustomerId]
	,[EmployerId]
	,[JobTitleId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[EmploymentPositionTypeId]
	,[AnnualSalaryAmount]
	,[EmploymentClassificationId]
	,[EmployerRelationshipTypeId]
	,[EmploymentStatusId]
	,[EmploymentNote]
	,[EmployeeId]
	,[NatureOfIncome]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT
     SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.EmployerId AS EmployerId
	,SRC.JobTitleId AS JobTitleId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,SRC.EmploymentPositionTypeId AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,NULL AS AnnualSalaryAmount
	,NULL AS EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,SRC.EmploymentStatusId AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,SRC.EmployeeId AS EmployeeId
	,SRC.NatureOfIncome AS NatureOfIncome
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	, 0 AS WorkFlowId
	, 0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmployment  (
	[CustomerId]
	,[EmployerId]
	,[JobTitleId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[EmploymentPositionTypeId]
	,[AnnualSalaryAmount]
	,[EmploymentClassificationId]
	,[EmployerRelationshipTypeId]
	,[EmploymentStatusId]
	,[EmploymentNote]
	,[EmployeeId]
	,[NatureOfIncome]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT
     CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,EmployerId AS EmployerId
	,JobTitleId AS JobTitleId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,EmploymentPositionTypeId AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,NULL AS AnnualSalaryAmount
	,NULL AS EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,EmploymentStatusId AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,EmployeeId AS EmployeeId
	,NatureOfIncome AS NatureOfIncome
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	, 0 AS WorkFlowId
	, 0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA;

END
